A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DIWALI research and contain 28 pages, including Appendices A–J. Complete text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the text, equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original cultural-adaptation experiments with seven LLMs on GSM8k, MGSM, DailyDialog and ROCStories, including automatic scores, LLM-judge assessments and human evaluations (Tables 1–5).

after.justification: v2 retains the original seven-model experiments, human evaluations, statistical results and subregional analyses reported in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Dataset construction and verification, the cultural-adaptation procedure, scoring methods and Appendix J prompts are identical. No model component or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both retain DIWALI's 8,817 items across 17 facets and 36 Indian subregions, the same four evaluation datasets, and the same English/Bengali prompt coverage.

E2.justification: CANDLE and DOSA remain the comparison CSI resources in Tables 1–3, with the same seven evaluated Llama, Mistral and Gemma models. Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the main and appendix comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4 retains the same test sets, sample counts, model configurations, metrics and human-evaluation design. Appendix C retains the same greedy decoding and 2,048-token generation limit.

E4.justification: The CANDLE false-positive audit, surface-versus-deep adaptation case studies, human/LLM-judge comparison and subregional heatmaps are unchanged (Section 6; Appendices A, H and I).

E5.justification: Both disclose a single generation run, 95% bootstrap intervals using 10,000 resamples, paired randomisation tests, Benjamini–Hochberg correction and Cohen's kappa reporting (Appendices C–D; Table 5).

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged, including appendix statistics and heatmaps. For example, Table 4b retains human cultural-relevance scores of 2.68 for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and 0.75 for Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct.

T1.justification: The cultural-adaptation task definition and exact/fuzzy matching formulation of the Adaptation Score in Section 4 are identical. No mathematical definition, assumption, derivation or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same dataset contributions, seven-model assessment and claims about uneven subregional coverage and shallow cultural adaptation.

C2.justification: Interpretations of surface-level substitutions and inflated LLM-judge scores are unchanged. The limitations concerning model coverage, the small qualitative sample and annotator diversity also remain identical.

D1.justification: Inference settings, GPU specifications, evaluation rubrics, annotator details and prompts are unchanged. Dataset and code access links also retain the same destinations.

R1.justification: Section 7 and the references are identical, including the positioning relative to CANDLE and DOSA. No cited work or substantive novelty relationship changes.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp updates from v1 dated 22 September 2025 to v2 dated 16 December 2025. PDF title metadata changes 'DIWALI -' to 'DIWALI:'. The visible title, prose, headings and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions and page layout are unchanged. Pages 2–28 render identically; the only visible first-page difference is the version/date stamp text.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, evidence, explanations and reproducibility information are identical, including all appendix analyses and prompts. The version/date stamp and title-metadata edits do not meaningfully improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
